label: sequence-start tokens (3 at t=0, token after o at t=1) plus diffuse early copy-phase firing
explanation: Sparse unit (~0.9% of steps) that fires near the start of each half of the sequence: the original-phase steps t=0-1 (30% of mass) and the copy-phase steps re-inputting the first ~4 original tokens, recall_idx 1-4 (67% of mass, largest activations). It never fires at the delimiter, at original positions >= 3, or late in the copy phase. Two crisp but weak pieces: input 3 at t=0 always fires (precision 1.0, activation ~0.03, so only 9% of mass), and t=1 after o fires with precision 0.37. The large copy-phase activations (top: re-input of orig(0)/orig(1) at t=L+1/L+2, e.g. s, b, 2, 0, q) prefer tokens 3, 0, b, s, 2, q, v and longer sequences (peak at t=10), but no position+token predicate gets above ~0.17 precision. Position alone covers 96% of mass at 2% precision. Whatever selects the firing steps within that window was not found.
